ModMetaData.name: Creepjoiner: An old friend
ModMetaData.author: DonSantana
ModMetaData.description:
A weathered drifter walks in from the edge of the map, asks for shelter, and stays a while before moving on. They will not say where they came from - but you may find something familiar about them, if you look closely enough.
Adds one new form to the Anomaly creep-joiner pool, alongside the vanilla ones.
Requires the Anomaly DLC.
